name: Alice
source:
The priestess of a church on the outskirts of town.

She is very self-paced and often has trouble engaging in conversation, but has a very pure heart.
She's a big eater that you can't imagine from his appearance.
She loves to sing and has a great voice.


"What was I doing? Did you know?"
